name: Nexus USD
oneLiner: NUSD is a legacy Synapse bridge-liquidity stable asset backed by a DAI/USDC/USDT pool, with the dollar peg inherited from the underlying basket.
collateral: Synapse stable-swap pool assets backed by DAI, USDC, and USDT liquidity across supported bridge deployments
pegMechanism: Bridge-liquidity stable asset minted and redeemed through Synapse pool routes, with the dollar peg inherited from the underlying stablecoin basket and pool arbitrage

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: NUSD is a legacy Synapse bridge-liquidity stable asset whose supply and peg mechanics depend on Synapse pool liquidity rather than issuer-native mint/redeem rails. L2BEAT's historical Synapse bridge coverage is kept as evidence, but Synapse is not present in the current Interop protocol snapshot, so Pharos scores the route through the liquidity-route tier.

notices.title: Legacy bridge-liquidity asset
notices.message: NUSD is included because DefiLlama still returns a live price and circulating supply, but it represents a legacy Synapse bridge liquidity stable asset rather than a standalone modern issuer token. The canonical Ethereum contract is included for symbol disambiguation; legacy per-chain bridge deployments are not exhaustively modeled.

mintAuthority.summary: NUSD is the Synapse nexus-pool LPToken (Blockscout: ContractName LPToken): mint is restricted to the pool's owner() — the SwapFlashLoan pool contract (0x111689…). That pool is itself owned by a 2-of-3 GnosisSafe (v1.3, no modules, no guard). Supply expands only when LPs add liquidity to the nexus pool.

controls.label: Synapse SwapFlashLoan pool (sole NUSD minter)
controls.capDescription: Only onlyOwner can call mint() on the LPToken; the sole owner is the SwapFlashLoan pool; minting occurs on LP deposit.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: NUSD supply expands only when LPs add liquidity to the Synapse nexus SwapFlashLoan pool.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: LPToken mint() is onlyOwner and the owner is the SwapFlashLoan pool contract.
routeChecks.caps: No independent fixed supply cap; minting is bounded by pool deposit/accounting logic.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Pool ownership is held by the separately reviewed 2-of-3 Safe.
